verdict.rationale: React is a client-side UI component library with no network or HTTP service API, so an OpenAPI-style spec for a service is outside its product category. The evidence fits that picture: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. llms.txt is documentation, not an API spec, and TypeScript typings via @types/react are a typing aid rather than a downloadable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
